subject: Marine Works - Fundy - Walton River
text:
Marine Works - Fundy - Walton River
Marine recycling work underway near the mouth of the Walton River, in 45 14.667N 064 02.697W. Work barge MM 180 and tug LOIS M are on site. All vessels are requested to maintain a safe distance and a low wake.
Contact on site: Jason Cooke 905-327-0219
